children: Several older Bitcoin mining rigs have fallen below their shutdown-price thresholds, with some models posting negative daily net earnings. According to Odaily, Antpool data show that multiple older models have entered loss-making territory with network mining difficulty remaining high and electricity priced at $0.06 per kilowatt-hour. The Whatsminer M66 (280T), Antminer S19 XP and Avalon A1466, released between 2021 and 2023, are among the models now recording negative daily net earnings and facing pressure to shut down.

title: Older Bitcoin Mining Rigs Fall Below Shutdown Prices, Some Models Post Daily Losses
